repl:
§fThis place? Oh well, when SOMEONE decided to mess with my console, you seemed to have overloaded it with fragments of my creations from past times, basically sucking you and a bunch of random stuff info this pocket dimension.
However when the console tried to divert excess energy to my home reality, it accidently brought in creations from there too, which is how I'm assuming you managed to find my Containment System and release... him.

As for the reason why your abilities do not work here, well thats most likely because it's been corrupted, the only powers that work here are powers that were brought through the rifts, which is why you obtained random abilities that you used to your advantage to take him down.

§f这个地方？唉，都怪「某个人」乱动我的控制台，你似乎让它超载了——我过去的造物碎片被灌了进去，结果把你和一堆乱七八糟的东西一起吸进了这个口袋维度。
不过当控制台试图把多余能量导回我所在的现实时，也意外带进了那边的造物——我猜你就是这样找到了我的收容系统，并放出了……他。

至于你的能力为什么在这里失效，多半是因为它们已经被腐化了。在这里唯一能生效的，就是从裂隙中带进来的力量。这也是为什么你获得了那些随机能力，并利用它们击败了他。

§fAh, you want to know what that was? He's a living entity I created imbued with fragments of my past self, he's not really fun to be around and would always try causing chaos or being egotistical because he thought he was better than everyone, he never knew he was a creation, he seems to think he's actually alive and has a grudge against me for banishing him after he caused too much drama and gave the name Heroic a bad reputation. He's basically just an alternate version of me I created, using abilities I had created and summoning echoes of my friends and creations... all while corrupting them.
You're lucky he wasn't capable of summoning the true potential of those echoes, if they had really been here you would've stood no chance as some of them are just as powerful as me...

§f啊，你想知道那是什么？他是我创造的一个活体，体内灌注了我过去自我的碎片。他一点都不好相处，总想惹是生非、自命不凡，因为他觉得自己比谁都强。他从不知道自己是被创造出来的，还真以为自己是活着的；他惹出太多乱子、败坏了 Heroic 这个名字，所以我把他放逐了，他因此怀恨在心。他基本上就是我创造出的「另一个我」，使用我创造的能力，召唤我朋友和造物的回响……并将它们全部腐化。
你应该庆幸他召唤不出那些回响真正的潜力——如果它们本体真的来了，你毫无胜算，因为其中一些和我一样强……

§fAh, you want to know what that was? He's a living entity I created imbued with fragments of my past self, he's not really fun to be around and would always try causing chaos or being egotistical because he thought he was better than everyone, he never knew he was a creation, he seems to think he's actually alive and has a grudge against me for banishing him after he caused too much drama and gave the name Heroic a bad reputation. He's basically just an alternate version of me, using abilities I had created and summoning friends of mine all while corrupting them.
You're lucky he wasn't capable of summoning the true potential of those echoes, if they had really been here you would've stood no chance as some of them are just as powerful as me...


 I know he's not evil to the core, after all he is me. He's just misunderstood and corrupted, which is why I sealed him away forever. But he doesn't realise it's for our own good.

§f啊，你想知道那是什么？他是我创造的一个活体，体内灌注了我过去自我的碎片。他一点都不好相处，总想惹是生非、自命不凡，因为他觉得自己比谁都强。他从不知道自己是被创造出来的，还真以为自己是活着的；他惹出太多乱子、败坏了 Heroic 这个名字，所以我把他放逐了，他因此怀恨在心。他基本上就是我的另一个版本，使用我创造的能力，召唤我的朋友们的虚影……并将它们全部腐化。
你应该庆幸他没能召唤出那些回响真正的潜力——如果它们本体真的来了，你毫无胜算，因为其中一些和我一样强……


 我知道他并非坏到骨子里，毕竟他就是我。他只是被误解又被腐化了，所以我才将他永远封印。但他不明白，这是为了我们大家好。

§fMy console? I have one in every reality where my authority reaches to control the flow of things, they're usually hidden pretty well but sometimes they can be unstable and allow things to leak into their reality.
Sometimes entities in that reality mess with it, taking components, worshipping it, creating artifacts and a ton of other nonsense allowing situations like this to happen.
Trust me you're not the first one I've talked to, this has happened several times before, it's kind of a nuisance at this point, however this time things were different as you somehow managed to break him out.

§f我的控制台？在每一个我权限所及的现实里我都放了一台，用来控制事物的流转。它们通常藏得很好，但有时会不稳定，让东西泄漏进那个现实。
有时那个现实里的家伙会乱动它——拆零件、膜拜它、制造圣物，干出一大堆蠢事，导致现在这种情况发生。
相信我，你不是第一个跟我聊这事的人，这种事以前发生过好几次，到现在都挺烦人了。不过这次不一样——你居然真的把他放出来了。

§fYou want to know about me? What's so important about me? I'm not even here, I'm sitting at home being lazy right now, you're just talking to another projection of me I put into this world. But other than that I'm the guy who created this all... ok well I don't create the realities but I'm responsible for the modifications added to all these realities or 'worlds'. In other words, Im similar to you, a player. You have the ability to do the same things I do if you try hard enough.
§f你想了解我？我有什么可重要的？我本人根本不在这儿——我正宅在家里摸鱼呢，你现在只是在跟我放进这个世界的另一个投影说话。除此之外，我是创造这一切的人……好吧，现实本身不是我创造的，但所有这些现实（或者说「世界」）里加入的修改都是我负责的。换句话说，我和你很像，也是个玩家。只要足够努力，你也能做到我做的这些事。

§fWhy did I take so long to arrive? I just cba...

Besides I get this sort of thing pretty often, when I'm creating such strong beings I often overlook how powerful I can really make them, sometimes they go out of control, atleast for other players to handle. Take astaroth for example, he originated from the island, however he managed to break through into another reality of mine, Meridia and caused chaos there.

Thankfully I had made the power system of that reality stronger than his prior reality, allowing even the weakest spells to cause harm to him, I eventually sealed him away but he managed to break through into this reality somehow, I'm not sure what or who freed him but I believe it may have been another one of my creations' influence, or worse, another player/creator... If that is the case, that means there's someone out there who could be a threat to me and my creations... I did feel a disturbance of some sort when you disrupted those rifts that artifact lead you to.

§f为什么我这么久才来？我就是懒得动……

再说这种事经常发生。我创造的生物太强时，我常常低估自己能让他们强到什么程度，有时他们就会失控——至少对其他玩家来说难以应付。就拿 Astaroth 来说吧，他起源于那座岛，却突破进入了我另一个现实 Meridia，在那里大闹了一场。

好在那个现实的力量体系比他原本的更强大，连最弱的法术都能伤到他，我最终把他封印了。但不知怎的，他又突破到了这个现实。我不确定是什么或是谁释放了他——我猜可能是我另一个造物的影响，或者更糟……是另一个玩家/创作者。如果是后者，那就意味着外面有个能威胁到我和我的造物的家伙……你扰乱那件圣物指引你找到的那些裂隙时，我确实感觉到了某种扰动。

§fOh right, you did do my chores for me I guess, even after causing this mess.
Fine... I guess I can give you a little something to make up for your efforts.

Here take this object, It's imbued with several creations of mine from the past and present, it should be useful, it'll be random whichever one you get though.

§f对了，你确实替我干了这些杂活——虽然这烂摊子本来就是你搞出来的。
好吧……看在你出了力的份上，我就给你点小东西作为补偿吧。

拿着这个。它灌注了我过去与现在的几件造物，应该会有用——不过你抽到哪一件是随机的哦。
